module: Third-party library lunajson (fast pure-Lua JSON decoder/encoder). This file is the entry point: it creates a default decoder and encoder and also exposes the SAX (event-driven) parser. To have several independent contexts, you can require lunajson/decoder or lunajson/encoder directly. The game also provides its own jsonEncode/jsonDecode functions; this is the raw library.
usage:
local lunajson = require('libs/lunajson/lunajson')
local t = lunajson.decode('{"a":[1,2,3]}')
local s = lunajson.encode(t)
notes: The file does `require 'libs/lunajson/lunajson.decoder'` (dot separator); the submodules are the files `lunajson/decoder.lua`, `encoder.lua` and `sax.lua`.

`decode(json, pos?, nullv?, arraylen?)`: if `pos` is given, also returns the position where decoding stopped (and does not require the end of the string); `nullv` replaces the JSON null (nil by default); if `arraylen` is true, the length of each decoded array is stored at index 0 (`ary[0]`).
`encode(value, nullv?)`: non-string keys in an object and circular references cause an error.

decode.desc: Decodes a JSON string into a Lua value (see lunajson/decoder).

encode.desc: Encodes a Lua value into a JSON string (see lunajson/encoder).

newparser.desc: Creates a SAX parser on a string or a source function (see lunajson/sax).

newfileparser.desc: Creates a SAX parser reading a file in 8192-byte blocks (see lunajson/sax).
